SELECT category as category, brand as brand, model as model, cal_trans_code as ct_code, cal_trans_rate as ct_rate, percent_ct_per_hour as percent_ct_hour, productivity_per_hour as productivity_hour, deployment_cost as deployment_cost, decommission_cost as decommission_cost, is_primary as is_primary
FROM equip_available
ORDER BY category, cal_trans_code

SELECT new_equip_available.equip_number as equip_numb, new_equip_available.cal_trans_code as ct_code, new_equip_available.year as year, new_equip_available.model as model, new_equip_available.cost_per_hour as calc_cost_per_hour, new_equip_available.productivity_per_hour as calc_productivity_hour, new_equip_available.price_to_buy as price_to_buy, new_equip_available.cash_paid , new_equip_available.loan_amount , new_equip_available.description as description, new_equip_available.is_in_marketplace as is_in_market, new_equip_available.is_in_fleet , new_equip_available.is_on_project , new_equip_available.company_id , new_equip_available.project_numb ,
equip_available.category as category, equip_available.brand as brand, equip_available.model as model_master, equip_available.productivity_per_hour as productivity_hour, equip_available.cal_trans_rate as ct_rate, equip_available.percent_ct_per_hour as percent_ct_hour
FROM new_equip_available
INNER JOIN equip_available
ON new_equip_available.cal_trans_code=equip_available.cal_trans_code
WHERE new_equip_available.adminid = #adminID#
ORDER BY equip_available.category

SELECT used_equip_available.equip_number as equip_numb, used_equip_available.cal_trans_code as ct_code, used_equip_available.year as year, used_equip_available.model as model, used_equip_available.serial_numb as serial_numb, used_equip_available.hours_of_use as hrs_of_use, used_equip_available.condition as condition, used_equip_available.cost_per_hour as calc_cost_per_hour, used_equip_available.productivity_per_hour as calc_productivity_hour, used_equip_available.price_to_buy as price_to_buy, used_equip_available.cash_paid , used_equip_available.loan_amount , used_equip_available.description as description, used_equip_available.is_in_marketplace as is_in_market, used_equip_available.is_in_fleet , used_equip_available.is_on_project , used_equip_available.company_id , used_equip_available.project_numb ,
equip_available.category as category, equip_available.brand as brand, equip_available.model as model_master, equip_available.productivity_per_hour as productivity_hour, equip_available.cal_trans_rate as ct_rate, equip_available.percent_ct_per_hour as percent_ct_hour
FROM used_equip_available
INNER JOIN equip_available
ON used_equip_available.cal_trans_code=equip_available.cal_trans_code
WHERE used_equip_available.adminid = #adminID#
ORDER BY equip_available.category

SELECT rental_equip_available.equip_number as equip_numb, rental_equip_available.cal_trans_code as ct_code, rental_equip_available.model as model, rental_equip_available.condition as condition, rental_equip_available.price_to_rent as price_to_rent, rental_equip_available.cost_per_hour as calc_cost_per_hour, rental_equip_available.productivity_per_hour as calc_productivity_hour, rental_equip_available.rental_term , rental_equip_available.description as description, rental_equip_available.is_in_marketplace as is_in_market, rental_equip_available.is_in_fleet , rental_equip_available.is_on_project , rental_equip_available.company_id , rental_equip_available.project_numb ,
equip_available.category as category, equip_available.brand as brand, equip_available.model as model_master, equip_available.productivity_per_hour as productivity_hour, equip_available.cal_trans_rate as ct_rate, equip_available.percent_ct_per_hour as percent_ct_hour
FROM rental_equip_available
INNER JOIN equip_available
ON rental_equip_available.cal_trans_code=equip_available.cal_trans_code
WHERE rental_equip_available.adminid = #adminID#
ORDER BY equip_available.category

SELECT cal_trans_code as ct_code
FROM equip_available
ORDER BY cal_trans_code

SELECT model
FROM equip_available
WHERE cal_trans_code = #ct_code[0]#

SELECT new_equip_available.equip_number as equip_numb, new_equip_available.model as model, new_equip_available.cost_per_hour as calc_cost_per_hour, new_equip_available.productivity_per_hour as calc_productivity_hour, new_equip_available.is_on_project , new_equip_available.company_id , new_equip_available.project_numb
FROM new_equip_available
INNER JOIN equip_available
ON new_equip_available.cal_trans_code=equip_available.cal_trans_code
WHERE new_equip_available.is_on_project = 't' AND new_equip_available.company_id = #value#
ORDER BY equip_available.category

SELECT used_equip_available.equip_number as equip_numb, used_equip_available.model as model, used_equip_available.cost_per_hour as calc_cost_per_hour, used_equip_available.productivity_per_hour as calc_productivity_hour, used_equip_available.is_on_project , used_equip_available.company_id , used_equip_available.project_numb
FROM used_equip_available
INNER JOIN equip_available
ON used_equip_available.cal_trans_code=equip_available.cal_trans_code
WHERE used_equip_available.is_on_project = 't' AND used_equip_available.company_id = #value#
ORDER BY equip_available.category

SELECT rental_equip_available.equip_number as equip_numb, rental_equip_available.model as model, rental_equip_available.cost_per_hour as calc_cost_per_hour, rental_equip_available.productivity_per_hour as calc_productivity_hour, rental_equip_available.is_on_project , rental_equip_available.company_id , rental_equip_available.project_numb
FROM rental_equip_available
INNER JOIN equip_available
ON rental_equip_available.cal_trans_code=equip_available.cal_trans_code
WHERE rental_equip_available.is_on_project = 't' AND rental_equip_available.company_id = #value#
ORDER BY equip_available.category
